name: Hobline
summary: A job desk for a kitchen-fitting firm: jobs board, crew week planner, quotes, stock and reports
about: A complete job desk for a small kitchen-fitting business in Lahore, from first enquiry to final handover. Jobs move along a board, crews are planned on a draggable week grid, quotes are built line by line, and every job carries a checklist, files, comments and a kitchen plan that draws itself. Good for kitchen fitters, joiners, bathroom fitters and other small trade firms.
how: Today shows the crews on site, money waiting on quotes and a featured job whose kitchen plan draws itself line by line. Hover a unit for its size.
On Jobs, drag a card to the next stage (or use the ⋯ menu). Click a card to open its drawer with details, checklist, plan, files and comments.
On Schedule, drag a job to another crew or day, or drag a booked job from the tray onto the grid. Step through weeks with the arrows.
On Quotes, build a quote line by line and watch the totals update. Mark it accepted and a booked job lands in the schedule tray.
Track stock on Materials, order items and receive deliveries. Reports show quoted vs invoiced, work by type, stage times and crew load.
Settings holds business details, crew names, notification switches, the theme and a Reset demo data button.
